seoWhatIs.metaTitle: What is a Portfolio X-Ray and how do you read it? | Portfolio X-Ray
seoWhatIs.metaDescription: Learn what Morningstar Instant X-Ray is, what the report includes, and how to interpret each metric: allocation, sectors, risk and returns.
seoWhatIs.h1: What is a portfolio <highlight>X-Ray</highlight> and how do you read it?
seoWhatIs.intro1: A portfolio X-Ray (officially Morningstar Instant X-Ray™) is a report that analyses an investment portfolio in depth from the funds, ETFs or stocks it contains. Instead of looking at each holding on its own, the X-Ray "opens" every fund and aggregates the underlying positions to show how your portfolio is really built: which countries, sectors, asset types and risk levels you actually have, beyond the fund names.
seoWhatIs.intro2: On Portfolio X-Ray you can <builderLink>build your portfolio</builderLink> by entering holdings and weights, and <builderLink>generate this report</builderLink> for free, without creating an account.
seoWhatIs.heroFree: Free, no account and no commitments
seoWhatIs.whoBody: Portfolio X-Ray does not generate the X-Ray PDF: our tool helps you build the portfolio and the link, and the report is generated through renta4banco using Morningstar Instant X-Ray™ technology. Morningstar Instant X-Ray is a trademark of Morningstar, Inc.; xrayportfolio.com is not affiliated with or endorsed by Morningstar.
seoWhatIs.includesTitle: What information does an X-Ray report include?
seoWhatIs.includesLead: Morningstar Instant X-Ray™ opens each fund and aggregates its underlying holdings to reveal the full picture of your investment.
seoWhatIs.question2: Which countries and sectors weigh the most?
seoWhatIs.question4: How much risk am I taking?
seoWhatIs.cardAllocationText: See how much you really hold in equities, bonds, cash and other categories.
seoWhatIs.cardGeoText: Identify countries, regions and emerging markets present in your portfolio.
seoWhatIs.cardRiskText: Review volatility, Sharpe, alpha, beta and correlations when they are available.
seoWhatIs.cardHoldingsText: Spot real concentration in underlying stocks and bonds.
seoWhatIs.allocationBody: The first block of the report shows what percentage of your portfolio sits in each broad category: equities, bonds, cash, and other assets (such as real estate) that Morningstar classifies separately. It also shows the portion that could not be classified.
seoWhatIs.geoBody: The X-Ray breaks your portfolio down by country and by major world region (Americas, Europe, Asia), and within each region by market development. This lets you see, for example, whether your portfolio is heavily concentrated in the United States or has real emerging-market exposure, even if your fund names do not say so explicitly.
seoWhatIs.sectorsBody: It shows your portfolio weight in each economic sector, grouped into three blocks: cyclical (basic materials, cyclical consumer, financial services, real estate), sensitive (communication, energy, industrials, technology) and defensive (defensive consumer, healthcare, utilities).
seoWhatIs.styleBody: "Style" crosses two variables: whether the companies in the portfolio are value, blend or growth, and whether they are small, mid or large cap. Alongside this you will see ratios such as price/book, price/earnings and price/cash flow, which indicate whether the portfolio is invested in relatively "expensive" or "cheap" companies.
seoWhatIs.top10Body: A list of the individual assets (underlying stocks or bonds) with the largest real weight in your portfolio, showing type, sector and country — very useful for spotting concentration in a single company even if you hold several different funds.
seoWhatIs.performanceTitle: Returns and risk (if the report includes them)
seoWhatIs.performanceLead: When the X-Ray includes performance analysis, it compares your portfolio with a benchmark and shows:
seoWhatIs.performance1: Cumulative returns over 3 months, 6 months, 1, 3 and 5 years versus the benchmark.
seoWhatIs.performance2: Volatility: how much the portfolio value moves relative to its average.
seoWhatIs.performance3: Sharpe ratio: return earned per unit of risk taken — the higher it is, the better the risk-adjusted return.
seoWhatIs.performance4: Alpha: the difference between what the portfolio actually returned and what was expected given its risk.
seoWhatIs.performance5: Beta: how sensitive the portfolio is to market moves (Beta greater than 1 = more volatile than the market; Beta less than 1 = less volatile).
seoWhatIs.performance6: Correlation matrix: how the funds in your portfolio move relative to each other. A correlation close to -1 indicates maximum diversification; close to 1, that the funds tend to rise and fall together.
seoWhatIs.unsupportedTitle: Which assets an X-Ray can analyse (and which it cannot)
seoWhatIs.unsupportedLead: Morningstar Instant X-Ray is designed mainly for UCITS funds, ETFs, ETCs and stocks. It is not set up to analyse correctly:
seoWhatIs.unsupportedNote: If you add any of these products in the <builderLink>builder</builderLink>, we will warn you that they are not recommended and the report will omit them.
seoWhatIs.faq1Q: Is generating a portfolio X-Ray free?
seoWhatIs.faq1A: Yes. Generating the report is free and does not require creating an account. You only need an account if you want to save your portfolio, mark it as a favourite or comment.
seoWhatIs.faq2Q: Does Portfolio X-Ray generate the PDF?
seoWhatIs.faq2A: No. Portfolio X-Ray helps you build the portfolio and the link; the final PDF is generated by renta4banco using Morningstar Instant X-Ray technology.
seoWhatIs.faq3Q: How many assets can I analyse?
seoWhatIs.faq3A: You can add as many assets as you want, entering the weight of each one until you reach 100% (or, in amount mode, entering the amount invested in each one).
seoWhatIs.faq4Q: What if an asset does not show correctly in the report?
seoWhatIs.faq4A: Sometimes a fund is not mapped correctly when the PDF is generated. If you see a blank gap or a missing holding, write to us through the <contactLink>contact form</contactLink> with the asset ISIN so we can correct it manually.
seoWhatIs.ctaTitle: Want to generate the X-Ray of your own portfolio?
seoWhatIs.ctaBody: Create your X-Ray for free and see the real composition of your investments.
seoWhatIs.seeAlso: See also: <howItWorksLink>How the portfolio X-Ray generator works</howItWorksLink>

seoHowItWorks.metaTitle: How the Portfolio X-Ray Generator Works | Portfolio X-Ray
seoHowItWorks.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide: add your assets by ISIN, set the weights and generate your Morningstar Instant X-Ray for free, with no account required.
seoHowItWorks.h1: How the portfolio X-Ray generator works
seoHowItWorks.intro: Portfolio X-Ray lets you build your investment portfolio and generate its Morningstar Instant X-Ray™ report in a few steps, without creating an account. Here is each step in detail.
seoHowItWorks.addIntro: In the <builderLink>builder</builderLink>, enter your assets one by one.
seoHowItWorks.addReliable: The most reliable way to identify them is with:
seoHowItWorks.addIsin: ISIN (a 12-character code, for example IE00B4L5Y983 or LU1206943596)
seoHowItWorks.addMatchNote: With an ISIN or Morningstar ID, the match is usually immediate.
seoHowItWorks.searchIntro: You can also search by ticker (for example NKE, ADBE) or by name (for example "Vanguard FTSE 100"). In those cases:
seoHowItWorks.search1: There are often several possible matches.
seoHowItWorks.search2: You will have to confirm which instrument is the right one.
seoHowItWorks.search3: Resolution is slower and less precise than with an ISIN or Morningstar ID.
seoHowItWorks.searchTip: Recommendation: use the ticker or name only if you do not have the ISIN to hand. Next time, copy it directly from the fund factsheet — it will save you steps.
seoHowItWorks.unresolvedTitle: If an asset does not resolve
seoHowItWorks.unresolvedIntro: If the system cannot find the product:
seoHowItWorks.unresolved1: Open the fund page on Morningstar.
seoHowItWorks.unresolved2: Copy the Morningstar ID from the URL (or paste the quote URL directly).
seoHowItWorks.unresolvedDuplicate: You cannot add the same asset twice (same ISIN, ticker or Morningstar ID).
seoHowItWorks.weightsTitle: 2. Set the weights: percentage or amount
seoHowItWorks.percentBody: You enter the weight of each position. The total must reach 100% to generate the X-Ray. The tool always shows the accumulated total and what is still missing.
seoHowItWorks.amountBody: You enter the amount of money invested in each position, and the builder calculates the percentages automatically. In this mode the numbers do not need to add up to a specific total: positive amounts are enough.
seoHowItWorks.privacyBody: If you use cash amounts, they are stored for you and you see them when you reopen your portfolio. Nobody else sees them: when you share your portfolio, on <exploreLink>Explore</exploreLink> or on the public page, only percentages are shown, never the absolute figures.
seoHowItWorks.generateBody: When every asset is resolved and the total reaches 100% (in percentage mode), press <builderLink>Generate X-Ray</builderLink>. Your builder builds a link with your assets and weights and sends it to renta4banco, which generates the Morningstar Instant X-Ray™ report from that data. We do not create the PDF ourselves: it is generated on the spot through that service.
seoHowItWorks.generateCopyLink: Copy the generated report link to share it as-is.
seoHowItWorks.unsupportedTitle: Which products do not work well in the X-Ray
seoHowItWorks.unsupportedBody: Instant X-Ray mainly covers UCITS funds, ETFs, ETCs and stocks. It is not designed for pension plans (PP), EPSV/PPSI or hedge funds (FIL). If you add them, we will warn you that they are not recommended and the report will omit them.
seoHowItWorks.pdfIssueTitle: If an asset does not appear correctly in the generated PDF
seoHowItWorks.pdfIssueBody: Sometimes a fund is not mapped correctly when the report is generated. If you open the PDF and see a blank gap where a position should be, or a holding from your portfolio is missing, write to us through the <contactLink>contact form</contactLink> with the affected asset ISIN so we can correct it manually as soon as possible.
seoHowItWorks.saveBody: You can save your portfolio with a name, an optional description and a visibility setting, and share a link with anyone you want. Anyone who opens that link will see the same composition in the builder and can generate the X-Ray, adjust it or save it as their own.
seoHowItWorks.saveLinkTypes: There are two types of link:
seoHowItWorks.saveBuilderLink: Builder / portfolio link: reloads the same assets and weights so you can keep editing.
seoHowItWorks.saveReportLink: X-Ray report link: goes directly to the PDF that has already been generated.
seoHowItWorks.saveAccount: To save you need an account with a verified email. If you have not signed in yet, pressing "Save" will ask you to <registerLink>register</registerLink> or <loginLink>sign in</loginLink>, and you can then finish saving without losing what you had already built.
seoHowItWorks.visibilityIntro: When you save, you choose the visibility of your portfolio:
seoHowItWorks.tableOthers: Others can open it, copy the link and mark it as a favourite
seoHowItWorks.tableYou: You can open it in the <builderLink>builder</builderLink>
seoHowItWorks.visibilityDefault: By default a new portfolio is created as public, although you can change it later from the builder toggle or when you edit it.
seoHowItWorks.myPortfoliosNote: In <portfoliosLink>My portfolios</portfoliosLink> you can see all of yours (public and private), open them in the <builderLink>builder</builderLink>, edit their name, description or visibility, view their X-Ray or delete them.
seoHowItWorks.exploreIntro: <exploreLink>Explore portfolios</exploreLink> shows only other users' public portfolios (plus your own public ones). From there you can:
seoHowItWorks.explore1: Filter by portfolio name or by user.
seoHowItWorks.explore2: Sort by most recent or by most favourited.
seoHowItWorks.explore3: Open the page, view the X-Ray or copy that portfolio's link.
seoHowItWorks.explore4: Open it in the <builderLink>builder</builderLink> to start from the same composition as your own base.
seoHowItWorks.favoritesBody: Favourites: on any public portfolio that is not yours, you can add it to favourites and find it later in <favoritesLink>My favourites</favoritesLink>. You need to be registered.
seoHowItWorks.commentsBody: Comments: on a portfolio's public page you can comment, edit or delete your own comments. This also requires an account — if you comment without signing in, you will be asked to <registerLink>register</registerLink> and the text you wrote is not lost.
seoHowItWorks.accountIntro: Creating an account is optional to generate an X-Ray, but required to save portfolios, add favourites or comment. With an account you can:
seoHowItWorks.account4: Change your name, username and language from your <profileLink>profile</profileLink>.
seoHowItWorks.account5: <loginLink>Sign in</loginLink> with email or with Google.
seoHowItWorks.account6: Set or change your password from your <profileLink>profile</profileLink>.
seoHowItWorks.account7: Delete your account from your <profileLink>profile</profileLink> (your portfolios stop being visible to others).
seoHowItWorks.accountRegister: <registerLink>Registration</registerLink> requires confirming that you are 18 and accepting the <termsLink>terms</termsLink> and <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink>. After registering with email, you must verify your email (the verification link expires in 24 hours) before you can save portfolios.
seoHowItWorks.summary2: Add your assets with an ISIN or Morningstar ID (ticker or name only if you do not have the code).
seoHowItWorks.summary3: Set percentages until you reach 100%, or cash amounts (percentages are calculated automatically; the amount is never shown to others).
seoHowItWorks.summary4: Press <builderLink>Generate X-Ray</builderLink> and open the PDF.
seoHowItWorks.summary5: If an asset does not appear correctly or is missing from the PDF, <contactLink>write to us</contactLink> with its ISIN so we can correct it.
seoHowItWorks.summary6: Save and share the link so someone else can load the same builder.
seoHowItWorks.summary7: Choose public visibility (appears in <exploreLink>Explore</exploreLink>, allows favourites and comments) or private (only you).
seoHowItWorks.ctaTitle: Still not sure what an X-Ray actually is or how to interpret its results?
seoHowItWorks.ctaWhatIs: Read the guide <whatIsLink>What is a portfolio X-Ray and how to read it</whatIsLink> to understand each block of the report.
